renderer: inline SVG sentence seam with produced glyph geometry
memoryRule: a held pressure sweep is geometry-neutral; release cuts the sentence at a material hinge, opens one glyph, hollows another, and drifts a third; later cuts inherit the broken sentence
interactionRule: pointer or touch drags across the sentence seam and releases; Arrow keys, Enter, Space, and the pressure control use deterministic sweeps; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas phoneme ecology, WebGL pressure rack, and browser-native double register -> one inline SVG sentence whose glyphs become a load-bearing seam
compositionRupture: distributed fragments, depth-staggered molds, and split registers -> one folded continuous sentence with a latent diagonal cut
encounterRupture: attend and speak, press and hold, and approach then leave -> drag pressure through a seam and release to produce a break
temporalRupture: attention ledger, elapsed pressure, and departure memory -> irreversible-looking sentence cuts with four exact lifts
mediumRupture: Canvas 2D text, raw WebGL, and DOM text/CSS -> inline SVG text and path geometry with actual glyph modes
changedRule: Pressure is geometry-neutral while held. A complete sweep cuts the folded sentence at a material hinge: one glyph opens, one hollows, and one drifts.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one continuous typographic seam rather than a field of fragments. A valid release produces a visible cut, hollow letter, drift, and seam scar in the sentence; four cuts remain visible and later releases inherit them.
falsifier: Delete if preview pressure changes glyph geometry, if the input point is merely selected, if the cut exists only in colour or readout, if the blind field reads as a generic type specimen, or if later cuts reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v037 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the pressure-seam grammar from the last three handwriting works or if the weak hinge is not materially produced.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
